about.text: Frontend engineer with 4+ years of production experience building complex, customer-facing web applications. I care about code that lasts – readable, maintainable, and built with the people using it in mind. Currently expanding into full-stack development through a professional bootcamp (April–August 2026). resume.about: I'm a frontend engineer with more than 4 years of experience building complex, customer-facing web applications. My core stack is Vue.js + TypeScript. I'm currently expanding into full-stack development through a professional bootcamp (Apr–Aug 2026). I work independently, think in systems, and distill technical topics into clear, actionable points – whether in customer demos, sprint reviews, or retrospectives. I grasp complex relationships quickly and communicate them clearly, even to non-technical stakeholders. Code quality matters to me, but so does the quality of collaboration.

highlights.text: Years of experience as a Frontend Developer
Solo full-stack projects built from scratch

communication.title: Stakeholder & Team
communication.text: I have experience with customer demos, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. I translate technical topics into something non-technical stakeholders can act on.

communication.title: Working Independently
communication.text: From the first requirements conversation to go-live, I own the entire lifecycle of a feature. Even with unclear specs, I get to a structured result.

communication.title: New Technologies
communication.text: I've repeatedly used new technologies productively without formal onboarding. I learn fastest by working directly with the technology itself.

communication.title: AI-Assisted Development
communication.text: I use Claude Code deliberately – as a tool to speed up iteration and support quality, not as a replacement for my own understanding.

communication.title: Feedback & Iteration
communication.text: I like working in short loops: test early, get feedback quickly, adjust fast. I validated Altavio from day one with real users and TikTok testing.

communication.title: Documentation & Knowledge
communication.text: I think in systems and keep knowledge structured – in Obsidian, project notes, or clear code comments. Knowledge should be transferable and traceable.

communication.title: Initiative
communication.text: I don't wait to be told what to learn next. Side projects like Altavio come from genuine interest – as a learning ground, experimentation space, and proof of work.

communication.title: Quality Mindset
communication.text: Quality doesn't end at clean code for me. I also think about maintainability, user experience, and the people working with the result – both when building and when reviewing.

projects.title: Altavio
projects.stack: Vue 3 · Vite · Fastify · PostgreSQL · TypeScript · Prisma
projects.text: Solo full-stack project: GPX tracks are exported as animated video reels. The core is SVG animation, a geo-layer system via the Overpass API, and drag overlays for 1080×1920 output. Rendering runs through a custom canvas pipeline synced frame-accurately to a 0–1 progress value. TikTok testing was used early on for feature validation.

projects.title: Furbase
projects.text: Shelter-animal matching platform built with Next.js and React. Focus on server-side rendering, clean component architecture, and state management. Built as the capstone project of the full-stack bootcamp with an eye toward production readiness and maintainability.
